_comment: Cursor reads MCP servers from ~/.cursor/mcp.json (global) or .cursor/mcp.json (per-project). Copy the mcpServers block below into that file. Replace <PLACEHOLDERS>. Remove servers you do not need.

filesystem._comment: Read-only access to a project directory. Cursor already has its own workspace access, so add this only if you need read access to a directory outside the open workspace (e.g. a sibling repo).

github._comment: Reads issues, PRs, code search across repos. Useful when working across a multi-repo product.

sequential-thinking._comment: Structured scratchpad for multi-step reasoning. No external network, safe to leave on.
